SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, s.session_id AS sessionId, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, p.title AS title, COALESCE(p.poster_url, '') AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.min_price AS minPrice, s.max_price AS maxPrice, p.hot_score AS hotScore, p.want_count AS wantCount, s.session_status AS sessionStatus FROM performance_session s JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE s.city_name = #{cityName} AND s.session_status != 'OFFLINE' AND p.project_status != 'OFFLINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku WHERE ready_sku.session_id = s.session_id AND ready_sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' )
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND DATE(s.start_time) = CURDATE()
AND DATE(s.start_time) = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND YEARWEEK(s.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1)
AND WEEKDAY(s.start_time) IN (5, 6)
AND DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_session s2 JOIN performance_project p2 ON p2.project_id = s2.project_id WHERE s2.project_id = s.project_id AND s2.session_status != 'OFFLINE' AND p2.project_status != 'OFFLINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku2 WHERE ready_sku2.session_id = s2.session_id AND ready_sku2.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' ) AND s2.city_name = #{cityName}
AND p2.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND DATE(s2.start_time) = CURDATE()
AND DATE(s2.start_time) = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND YEARWEEK(s2.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1)
AND WEEKDAY(s2.start_time) IN (5, 6)
AND DATE_FORMAT(s2.start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
AND ( CASE WHEN s2.start_time >= NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END < CASE WHEN s.start_time >= NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END OR ( CASE WHEN s2.start_time >= NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = CASE WHEN s.start_time >= NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AND ( (s.start_time >= NOW() AND ( s2.start_time < s.start_time OR (s2.start_time = s.start_time AND s2.session_id < s.session_id) )) OR (s.start_time < NOW() AND ( s2.start_time > s.start_time OR (s2.start_time = s.start_time AND s2.session_id < s.session_id) )) ) ) ) )
ORDER BY p.publish_time DESC, s.start_time ASC, p.project_id ASC
ORDER BY p.hot_score DESC, p.want_count DESC, s.start_time ASC, p.project_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND DATE(s.start_time) = CURDATE()
AND DATE(s.start_time) = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND YEARWEEK(s.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1)
AND WEEKDAY(s.start_time) IN (5, 6)
AND DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT venue_id AS venueId, venue_name AS venueName, city_name AS cityName, address, longitude, latitude FROM venue ORDER BY venue_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FROM performance_session s JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE p.project_status != 'OFFLINE' AND s.session_status != 'OFFLINE' AND s.city_name = #{cityName} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku WHERE ready_sku.session_id = s.session_id AND ready_sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' ) AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.city_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.station_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.venue_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, COALESCE(p.poster_url, '') AS posterUrl, p.detail_content AS detailContent, p.min_price AS minPrice, p.max_price AS maxPrice, p.want_count AS wantCount, p.hot_score AS hotScore, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.publish_time AS publishTime, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM want_record w WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.project_id = p.project_id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wanted FROM performance_project p JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.project_status != 'OFFLINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_session ready_session WHERE ready_session.project_id = p.project_id AND ready_session.session_status <> 'OFFLINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku WHERE ready_sku.session_id = ready_session.session_id AND ready_sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' ) )

SELECT s.session_id AS sessionId, s.project_id AS projectId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.venue_id AS venueId, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, v.longitude AS longitude, v.latitude AS latitude, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, s.min_price AS minPrice, s.max_price AS maxPrice, s.limit_per_order AS limitPerOrder, s.station_detail_content AS stationDetailContent, s.delivery_type AS deliveryType FROM performance_session s JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.session_status != 'OFFLINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku WHERE ready_sku.session_id = s.session_id AND ready_sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' ) ORDER BY s.start_time ASC, s.session_id ASC

SELECT s.session_id AS sessionId, s.project_id AS projectId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.venue_id AS venueId, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, v.longitude AS longitude, v.latitude AS latitude, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, s.min_price AS minPrice, s.max_price AS maxPrice, s.limit_per_order AS limitPerOrder, s.station_detail_content AS stationDetailContent, s.delivery_type AS deliveryType FROM performance_session s JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.session_status != 'OFFLINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku WHERE ready_sku.session_id = s.session_id AND ready_sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' )

SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.description AS description, r.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM project_service_tag_rel r JOIN service_tag t ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.tag_name NOT IN ('条件退', '不可退') ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, t.tag_id ASC

SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, COALESCE(NULLIF(rr.rule_description, ''), t.description) AS description, 0 AS sortOrder FROM refund_rule rr JOIN service_tag t ON ( (rr.refund_type = 'CONDITIONAL_REFUND' AND t.tag_name = '条件退') OR (rr.refund_type = 'NO_REFUND' AND t.tag_name = '不可退') ) WHERE rr.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT CONCAT( CASE WHEN rs.max_before_start_minutes IS NULL THEN CONCAT('演出开始前', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END, '及以上') WHEN rs.min_before_start_minutes = 0 THEN CONCAT('演出开始前', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END, '内') ELSE CONCAT('演出开始前', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.min_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.min_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END, '至', CASE WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 1440) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 1440, '天') WHEN MOD(rs.max_before_start_minutes, 60) = 0 THEN CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes DIV 60, '小时') ELSE CONCAT(rs.max_before_start_minutes, '分钟') END) END, '：', CASE rs.stage_result WHEN 'FREE' THEN '免费退票' WHEN 'FEE_PERCENT' THEN CONCAT('收取', CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(rs.fee_rate, 0) * 100, 2) AS CHAR), '%手续费') WHEN 'FEE_FIXED' THEN CONCAT('收取￥', CAST(IFNULL(rs.fixed_fee_amount, 0) AS CHAR), '手续费') WHEN 'NOT_ALLOWED' THEN '不可退票' ELSE '以项目退款规则为准' END ) FROM refund_rule rr JOIN refund_rule_stage rs ON rs.refund_rule_id = rr.refund_rule_id WHERE rr.project_id = #{projectId} AND rr.refund_type = 'CONDITIONAL_REFUND' ORDER BY rs.sort_order ASC, rs.stage_id ASC

SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.title_override, ''), n.title) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.description_override, ''), n.description) AS description, COALESCE(n.icon_url, '') AS iconUrl, n.notice_type AS noticeType, r.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM project_notice_rel r JOIN notice_item n ON n.notice_id = r.notice_id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, n.notice_id ASC

SELECT sku.sku_id AS skuId, sku.project_id AS projectId, sku.session_id AS sessionId, sku.sku_name AS skuName, sku.sku_desc AS skuDesc, sku.price AS price, CASE WHEN sku.inventory_authority <> 'LOCAL_COMPAT' AND skum.mapping_id IS NOT NULL AND skum.available_stock_snapshot IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE sku.stock_available END AS stockAvailable, sku.stock_locked AS stockLocked, sku.sold_count AS soldCount, sku.sku_status AS skuStatus, sku.sort_order AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN sku.inventory_authority <> 'LOCAL_COMPAT' AND skum.mapping_id IS NOT NULL AND skum.available_stock_snapshot IS NULL THEN s.limit_per_order ELSE LEAST(s.limit_per_order, sku.stock_available) END AS maxSelectableQuantity FROM ticket_sku sku JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = sku.session_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping skum ON skum.sku_id = sku.sku_id AND skum.mapping_status = 'BOUND' WHERE sku.session_id = #{sessionId} AND sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' ORDER BY sku.sort_order ASC, sku.sku_id ASC
